parameters.jsCode:
function window({scheduledAt,overrideDay}){const n=new Date(scheduledAt);if(!Number.isFinite(n.getTime()))throw Error('Invalid schedule time');if(typeof overrideDay!=='string')throw Error('Invalid replay date');let start,end;if(overrideDay){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(overrideDay))throw Error('Replay date must be YYYY-MM-DD');start=new Date(overrideDay+'T00:00:00.000Z');if(!Number.isFinite(start.getTime())||start.toISOString().slice(0,10)!==overrideDay)throw Error('Invalid replay date');end=new Date(start.getTime()+86400000);}else{end=new Date(Date.UTC(n.getUTCFullYear(),n.getUTCMonth(),n.getUTCDate()));start=new Date(end.getTime()-86400000)}const search="created_at:>='"+start.toISOString()+"' created_at:<'"+end.toISOString()+"'";return{search,variables:{query:search}};}

return [{json:window({scheduledAt:new Date().toISOString(),overrideDay:''})}];
